records.title: 10-K - 2020
records.text: • Revenue was $1.23 billion, a decrease of 1.6% over the $1.25 billion in 2019;

records.title: 10-K - 2020
records.text: Average unit cost increased 1.5% for the twelve months ended December 31, 2020, compared to the same period last year, due to lower capacity utilization for the year, driven by COVID-19 pandemic related manufacturing plant closures and the associated slowdown in customer demand in early 2020.

records.title: 10-K - 2020
records.text: Cost of goods sold is also affected by inventory obsolescence if our inventory management is not efficient.

records.title: 10-K - 2020
records.text: • Gross margin was 35.1% , a decrease of 220 basis points, compared to 37.3% in 2019;

records.title: 10-K - 2020
records.text: • Operating income decreased 33.0% to $134.3 million, or 10.9% of revenue, compared to $200.6 million, or 16.1%, of revenue in 2019;
